verdict.summary: The change correctly derives a closed-vocabulary, zero-sealed no-change reason census from the already validated canonical health ledger, folds absent declarations to the shared unspecified bucket, publishes no model-authored labels, and distinguishes an unavailable census from a measured zero population. The dashboard renders the census before the empty-check return, so all-no-change and quiet-ledger snapshots remain observable. The self-tests exercise the production normalization path and the executed page renderer, pin independent expected names/counts/order, cover zero, null, malformed display values, timestamp span, singular wording, and the placement seam. No trust check, permission boundary, token handling, or workflow surface is weakened. No reviewer-directed instruction was present in the diff.
